name: Translation Token Audit
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
tip: Select Open target line on a result row to open the target note at that line.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Translation Token Audit is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to check your translations.
